how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-un-goro-crater-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:5150:progress:0: ⟦E13⟧ looks up at you as you approach her. She seems to be hoping for something...⟦25⟧⟦26⟧She's probably hungry!⟦27⟧⟦28⟧There's got to be something growing in the crater that would be just the perfect snack for a large herbivore. ⟦E13⟧'s a big girl; whatever you bring her, there would need to be a lot of it!
rows.quest:5150:completion:0: Placing the sprouts in front of her, ⟦E13⟧ seems pleased.⟦29⟧⟦30⟧She nudges a small brown-wrapped package towards you, in exchange for the treat!
rows.quest:3884:obj:0: Return the journal to ⟦E15⟧ somewhere in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:3884:details:0: You have uncovered a mangled journal. Parts of it remain legible, with a ⟦E15⟧ claiming ownership over the contents therein. If the journal is accurate, then Williden may be found somewhere in the northern part of the Crater; according to the journal, he and his companions sought higher ground from the savage beasts of the Crater once their base camps were overrun.
rows.quest:3884:progress:0: Hello there!  I and my companions are happy to see some living beings here other than overgrown savage beasts!  What brings you into the ⟦E16⟧?
rows.quest:3884:completion:0: Well look at this - my journal! I thought it was lost, much like almost everything else we brought into Un'Goro. I thank you kindly for returning this to me!
rows.quest:3882:details:0: You'd think that being chief digger for Marshal Expeditions means I like digging. There might be worse things to do in this world... but none really leap to mind.
rows.quest:3882:details:1: We were supposed to be digging in Terror Run - FANTASTIC name by the way - for dead stegodons and diemetradons. Well, there are plenty of live ones there too! Wil and Hol are still all about studying this death trap, so we need those dinosaur bones. Between you and me though, bringing some from live ones will work out just as well.
rows.quest:3882:progress:0: Think whatever you want of me, but they're not going to care if the bones they get to research are from ones from ancient stegodons and diemetradons or the ones that almost devoured us wholesale when we were trying to set up our camps.  I'll just be happy if we get out of here alive...
rows.quest:3882:completion:0: Excellent, these should do the trick. And now, if you'll permit me...
rows.quest:3882:completion:1: BTHANKS FOR DIGGING ALL OF THESE BONES OUT OF THE GROUND FOR US AND NOT HURTING THE NATIVE BEASTS IN ANY WAY.
rows.quest:3882:completion:2: Whether you really did or didn't, I don't want to know. Let's keep it that way, shall we? Here - maybe this will keep your lips shut on the whole thing. Anything to get out of here alive, I say!
rows.quest:4503:obj:0: Collect 8 Webbed ⟦E19⟧ Scales and 8 Webbed ⟦E20⟧ Scales for ⟦E21⟧ in Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4503:details:1: I got stranded here, and I'm absolutely horrible at finding my way around. I'd take a gryphon or wind rider back to Gadgetzan, but those beasts just scare me to death.
rows.quest:4503:details:2: So, will you help me? All I have left to build is the wings, and I was thinking that the webby scales from the pterrordax and diemetradon would be perfect. There's no way I'm going to go up against one of those, but you look pretty tough. Why don't you give it a try?
rows.quest:4503:progress:0: Every great vehicle needs a name... I was thinking I'd call it... Pwned!
rows.quest:4503:completion:0: Yes, these scales are perfect. I should be able to get this flyer off the ground with these scales for sure!
rows.quest:3844:obj:0: Look around in the pond for a clue about who this wrecked raft may belong to.
rows.quest:3844:details:0: A destroyed raft rests along the shoreline. Considering this is only a small pond, it is not clear as to how it ended up here, although looking at the trees tells you that the water level may not be constant.
rows.quest:3844:details:1: Perhaps a little exploration in the area might uncover more clues...
rows.quest:3844:completion:0: A water-logged pack rests at the bottom of the pond.
rows.quest:3845:obj:0: Examine the items inside the pack and bring them to their owner.
rows.quest:3845:details:0: Grabbing onto it, you pull the pack back to the shore. Perhaps if you examine the items inside the pack, you might find out more about who it belongs to.
rows.quest:3845:details:1: There are a few stray travelers at Marshal's Refuge. Perhaps you might find out more there.
rows.quest:3845:progress:0: Hi there. I've seen you before... Haven't I?
rows.quest:3845:completion:0: Oh... Yes, these things do look familiar... well, kind of...
rows.quest:3883:obj:0: Use the Scraping Vial to collect a ⟦E24⟧ from one of the Gorishi hive hatcheries in ⟦E16⟧. Look for the chambers with the hanging larval spawns.
rows.quest:3883:details:0: Just because we've suffered a setback doesn't mean that research must stop! We were investigating the Gorishi insects in the southern part of the crater before winding up here. Their presence is alien to the ecology of Un'Goro, and we want to find out why.
rows.quest:3883:details:1: In their hive network must be larval hatcheries. You can identify these places by their hanging larval spawns. Use this vial to take a sample of the hive wall near any of the hatcheries. Bring it back to me for study, but be careful!
rows.quest:3883:progress:0: Do you have the sample of the Gorishi hive for me to study, ⟦31⟧?
rows.quest:3883:completion:0: Yes, this will do nicely. You've been a great help... I wish I could give you more than this, but being virtually stranded in the middle of a savage land does limit what I can and cannot give. Rest assured though - the research done here would not have been possible without your assistance!
rows.quest:3908:details:0: You see, I have no idea how I ended up here. No one really knows -- it's a secret to everybody! I just can't seem to remember anything...
rows.quest:3908:details:1: These items you brought to me, though... I am remembering something.
rows.quest:3908:details:2: My sword. I am supposed to strengthen it somehow, but I'm really not sure why. Sorry I can't tell you more, but I just don't remember!
rows.quest:3908:details:3: Anyhoo, I do know where you can take it -- ⟦E27⟧ in ⟦E28⟧. You'll find her by the hot springs. She can temper the sword by the pools there.
rows.quest:3908:progress:0: My, my... So ⟦E29⟧ did finally get around to sending me his sword.
rows.quest:3908:completion:0: Well, of course I can temper this sword. While I'm working, you can explain what took ⟦E29⟧ so long to get this to me. He's not usually one to forget things...
rows.quest:3909:obj:0: Seek out ⟦E30⟧ in northern ⟦E31⟧. From him, learn how you may acquire the ⟦E32⟧, then return to ⟦E27⟧ in ⟦E28⟧.
rows.quest:3909:details:1: Oh, I see... Lost his memory...
rows.quest:3909:details:2: Well, here is his sword. It's not complete, though. I know of the one that can finish it, but... speaking with him may prove difficult.
rows.quest:3909:details:3: Listen, I know of someone that will be able to help you. It's too much to explain right now, but you must somehow acquire a ⟦E32⟧. The only one I know that can help you with that is ⟦E30⟧. He's hard to track down, but last I knew he was camping in the wilds of ⟦E31⟧.
rows.quest:3909:completion:0: I'll need one vial to make sure that this is truly the elixir... Yes... This is the stuff.
rows.quest:3912:obj:0: Go to the graveyard outside Gadgetzan, and use the ⟦E32⟧. Follow the rest of Donova's instructions to find ⟦E34⟧.
rows.quest:3912:details:0: This elixir will allow you to speak with one that you would not normally even see...
rows.quest:3912:details:1: Take the Videre elixir, along with ⟦E29⟧'s sword, to the graveyard just outside Gadgetzan in ⟦E35⟧. Once there, drink the potion. You may be quite surprised at the results, but do not be alarmed.
rows.quest:3912:details:2: In your "other" form, head due north until you reach the mountains. You'll find the one you need to speak with in one of the rocky crevices. His name is ⟦E34⟧.
rows.quest:3912:details:3: Remember, he will only speak to you in that form...
rows.quest:3912:completion:0: It has been long since any have come to talk with me...
rows.quest:3913:obj:0: ⟦E37⟧, then look for the gravestone that ⟦E34⟧ told you to find.
rows.quest:3913:details:0: If you return to the graveyard, ⟦32⟧, you will find a gravestone there... Not just any gravestone; this one will stand out from the others. Secrets lie within it.
rows.quest:3913:details:1: Push on the stone, and you will learn of these secrets...
rows.quest:3913:progress:0: This must be the gravestone that ⟦E34⟧ mentioned...
rows.quest:3913:completion:0: You push on the stone firmly, and it slides away, revealing a small depression underneath it.
rows.quest:3913:completion:1: Placing ⟦E26⟧ into the depression, you realize that it fits perfectly...
rows.quest:3914:details:0: After a strong flash of light, you are able to pick up the sword again. It has been transformed!
rows.quest:3914:progress:0: Oh! I remember you! You are... No, don't tell me!
rows.quest:3914:completion:1: Now, if only I could remember why I needed this...
rows.quest:3914:completion:2: Here, let me at least pay you for your work.
rows.quest:3941:obj:0: Find ⟦E39⟧ in the cave at Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:3941:details:0: Thinking... Thinking... I know I came here for something important...
rows.quest:3941:details:1: I have an idea, ⟦33⟧. In the cave over there is a gnome named J.D. that was very kind to me when I first arrived here. Perhaps in my disoriented state, I might have mentioned something to her.
rows.quest:3941:details:2: Why don't you go ask her if she knows anything? Oh, but be careful -- she's always messing with those crazy glowing crystals I've seen in the crater. I'm not quite sure what she's up to in there!
rows.quest:3941:completion:0: Stay where you are for just a moment... I am testing out a new combination of crystals...
rows.quest:4141:details:0: See ⟦E41⟧ over there? It's HIS fault we're here!
rows.quest:4141:details:1: I told him we were going the wrong way, but would he listen? And would you believe that he's the one that won't speak to me? Well, until he changes his mind, let's have a bit of fun with him.
rows.quest:4141:details:2: Have you noticed the strange plant-like creatures around here? They're nothing but trouble, really, but I think if trained properly, I could get them to obey commands.
rows.quest:4141:details:3: First thing though, I'll need some samples to study. Do you think you could collect some?
rows.quest:4141:progress:0: ⟦E41⟧'s got something coming, that's for sure!
rows.quest:4141:completion:0: I hope they didn't give you too much trouble, ⟦34⟧. I try to steer clear of them -- they're wild!
rows.quest:4141:completion:1: I tried jumping over one... I was attacked! Plants just shouldn't be acting that way!
rows.quest:4142:details:0: I'm not quite sure what to make of this, ⟦35⟧. The plants... they seem to have some minimal intelligence.
rows.quest:4142:details:1: I'm no expert, though. But, I do know someone that is!
rows.quest:4142:details:2: Head to northern ⟦E31⟧, and look for a buddy of mine named ⟦E30⟧. He's an expert on this sort of thing.
rows.quest:4142:details:3: I'm sure Gregan can help us out here. You'll find him out in the wilderness; he's not the type to live in a big city.
rows.quest:4142:progress:0: I live out here in the forest... Peaceful.⟦36⟧⟦37⟧Well, at least I thought it would be. I get more visitors out here than I ever did when I lived in ⟦E45⟧!
rows.quest:4142:completion:0: ⟦E43⟧, eh? Hmmm... Well, you better explain the plan, and then I'll tell you whether or not I can help you.
rows.quest:4143:obj:0: Collect 5 samples of ⟦E46⟧, then return to ⟦E40⟧ in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:4143:details:0: To tell you the truth, ⟦38⟧, I've never seen any plants like this in my travels. Perhaps I should take a trip to this crater...
rows.quest:4143:details:1: At any rate, I think I know just the thing ⟦E40⟧'s looking for -- Atal'ai haze. It's horrid stuff, hard to collect, but it's just what he needs to control the little monsters.
rows.quest:4143:details:2: You'll need to visit the temple of Atal'Hakkar in the ⟦E47⟧. The ⟦E46⟧ can be collected from the deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes found there. Good luck, ⟦39⟧!
rows.quest:4143:progress:0: ⟦E41⟧'s still not speaking to me! He sure knows how to hold a grudge.
rows.quest:4143:completion:0: I admit, I'm a bit hesitant to touch that stuff, ⟦40⟧! But if Gregan says it'll work, then I'm willing to give it a try!
rows.quest:4145:obj:0: Hunt 5 ⟦E43⟧ Lashers, 5 ⟦E43⟧ Threshers, 5 ⟦E43⟧ Flayers and 5 ⟦E43⟧ Trappers for ⟦E41⟧ at Marshal's Refuge.
rows.quest:4145:details:0: See ⟦E40⟧ over there? It's HIS fault we're lost!
rows.quest:4145:details:1: I'm the one that knew the way, but he insisted he knew a shortcut, and we ended up here!
rows.quest:4145:details:2: To make matters worse, now he keeps sending his crazy plant pests to annoy me. I'm so angry that I'm not planning on talking to him any time soon, but these pests are too much to handle.
rows.quest:4145:details:3: Why don't we try to limit his supply, first thing. Go out and hunt some Bloodpetals, then return to me.
rows.quest:4145:progress:0: ⟦E40⟧ needs to apologize first before I'll talk to him again!
rows.quest:4145:completion:0: Thanks for your help, ⟦41⟧, but I'm afraid I have some bad news...
rows.quest:4147:details:0: I managed to spy on what ⟦E40⟧ was doing, and he's actually growing the darn things over there!
rows.quest:4147:details:1: I think the only solution here is to... no, not go talk to him... What are you thinking? The solution is to fight back!
rows.quest:4147:details:2: We'll need the help of my friend, Marvon, who has a workshop in Ratchet. I'm sure he'll be able to create some sort of gadget that will help us.
rows.quest:4147:completion:0: Marvon's been gone quite a long time now, ⟦42⟧. He went off to ⟦E35⟧ to study some of the ancient troll ruins.
rows.quest:4147:completion:1: Now, what was it that you said you needed?
rows.quest:3881:details:0: I don't know how you made it here, but you're a sight for sore eyes! I'm ⟦E15⟧, and I lead a non-aligned expedition troupe. Our latest and greatest endeavor has met with what seems like countless disasters, the most serious of which being that we underestimated the savagery of ⟦E16⟧!
rows.quest:3881:details:1: As we fled our base camps in the southwestern and northeastern parts of the crater, we left behind vital supplies. You look like you're capable enough - can you help us by getting them back?
rows.quest:3881:progress:0: If we're going to have any chance of getting out of here alive, we'll need our big crate of foodstuffs.  Also, getting at least some of our research equipment back would be a blessing in a sea of misery.
rows.quest:3881:completion:0: You got both our foodstuff AND our research equipment back! You've not only saved the expedition, you've also saved our lives. I and the rest of my team can't thank you enough; we just might make it here for a while now thanks to you.
rows.quest:3881:completion:1: While we don't have much, I'm certainly not going to leave you high and dry for the invaluable help you've given us. Thank you, ⟦43⟧ - you've got a friend in Marshal Expeditions!
rows.quest:4144:progress:0: Here's the plan, ⟦44⟧: Go out and collect some bloodpetal sprouts -- you know, the plants that haven't fully sprouted yet, and bring them here. Then I'll see what the Atal'ai haze can do.⟦45⟧⟦46⟧You may think I'm vengeful... Actually, you'd be right about that!⟦47⟧⟦48⟧Truth is, I know the way out of here, but until ⟦E41⟧ will admit that I'm right, I'm staying right here!⟦49⟧⟦50⟧So off with you, find those bloodpetal sprouts and let's have some fun!
rows.quest:4144:completion:0: Here goes nothing, ⟦51⟧! This will get ⟦E41⟧'s attention!
rows.quest:4148:progress:0: For the zapper to work, it needs a sample of the target creature. Head out into the crater and collect a ⟦E43⟧ sprout. Then I can calibrate it to work on ⟦E40⟧'s little friends...⟦52⟧⟦53⟧If he weren't so stubborn, we could be on our way home, already... But until then, I'll just have to show him that his little prank doesn't bother me at all!
rows.quest:4148:completion:0: Looks like this is going to work perfectly, ⟦54⟧. Now remember, if you see any of those pests around, don't hesitate to use that zapper!
rows.quest:4243:details:0: Unfortunately, something's happened to one of my greatest inventions. You've seen mechanical squirrels, yes? Well, to get closer to the apes of ⟦E16⟧, I created a mechanical ape to blend in with their kind--I call her ⟦E55⟧.
rows.quest:4243:details:1: She has scrying gems for eyes so I could see everything she saw. She made it to Fungal Rock--the apes' lair--just east of here, and that's when I lost contact. The last thing I saw was one of their alpha males rushing up to say hello to her!
rows.quest:4243:details:2: Can you help me find her?
rows.quest:4243:completion:0: As you look ⟦E55⟧ over, you see two huge dents tarnishing what Karna obviously feels is a well-crafted piece of engineering. One dent decorates ⟦E55⟧'s shoulder, the other is on her head.
rows.quest:4243:completion:1: No power seems to be running through her components as you investigate further.
rows.quest:4244:obj:0: Find a ⟦E56⟧ and return to ⟦E55⟧ in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:4244:details:0: A little further investigation shows a panel that slides open. Clearly written above some wiring is the statement, "Replace ⟦E56⟧ And Turn Power Off Then On."
rows.quest:4244:details:1: Taking a moment to replace the panel, you wonder if it'll be that simple to fix ⟦E55⟧ and get her back to ⟦E57⟧ near Marshall's Refuge.
rows.quest:4244:progress:0: The panel in which the mithril casing goes is still closed shut. The rest of ⟦E55⟧ remains inert.
rows.quest:4244:completion:0: You remove the panel from ⟦E55⟧'s back yet again and carefully remove the old mithril casing that seems to have burnt out. The new one slides into place easily. The only thing left to do, assuming the mithril casing was the problem, is to flip the switch to the "Off" position, and then back to the "On" position.
rows.quest:4245:details:0: Checking to see if you're prepared to lead ⟦E55⟧ back to ⟦E57⟧, you flip the switch to the "Off" position. Glancing around once again to make sure none of the gorillas are coming, you prepare to see what happens when you flip the switch back to the "On" position.
rows.quest:4245:details:1: This is your last chance... are you sure this is what you want to do?
rows.quest:4245:progress:0: Have you been able to help A-Me? That mithril casing you mentioned being destroyed was a good guess at what was wrong. I'm sure if you replace that, she'll reactivate and be able to come home.
rows.quest:4245:completion:0: Oh, you've done it! Wonderful! Thank you, ⟦55⟧.
rows.quest:4245:completion:1: Oh, my poor, A-Me. Look at all those dents. We'll get her up and running perfectly with just a little work.
rows.quest:4245:completion:2: Thank you again, ⟦56⟧. I really appreciate it.
